heading: Away From the Desk
aside: The part that does not fit on a resume.
lines: Most weeks I sit with someone at Glenorchy Library who is trying to make a government website work on a phone they were handed last week. That is where you find out what a system is really like.
I help run STEAMM robotics workshops for six to twelve year olds in Rokeby — mostly by testing every robot and tablet before the children arrive, which is its own kind of engineering.
Nine ICT and professional events in one semester, with notes after each. A question I asked after SecTalks Hobart is how I ended up at an AISA Tasmania branch event as an invited guest.
From 2027 I mentor a high school student through Raise. The training was about what a young person actually needs from a mentor, which turns out not to be advice.
I tutor a classmate from a non-IT background across two units. Explaining a concept to someone who has no reason to already understand it is the fastest way to find out whether I do.
